summary: Alector, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with TD Cowen for up to $125 million of its common stock. The filing describes a routine equity distribution program under an existing shelf registration statement, with sales made at prevailing market prices and a 3.0% commission to TD Cowen. No premium, fixed price, tender, acquisition, or activist involvement is present. This is a standard capital-raising facility, not a special situation. Filing date: May 7, 2026.
